card.statement:
Assume that $\underline{\la}=(\la^{(1)},\la^{(2)},\ldots,\la^{(M)})$ is a collection of covariant $\gl_{m|n} (n\geq 1)$-weights with each $\la^{(s)}$ being nontrivial, $\underline{h}=(h^{(1)},\ldots,h^{(M)})$ belongs to $\BC^M$ with $h^{(a)}-h^{(b)}\in\BZ$ for all $1\leq a,b\leq M$, $i_s,j_s,k_s$ are defined above for $1\leq s\leq M$ and

\[
V_{\underline{h}}(\underline{\la})=L_{h^{(1)}}(\la^{(1)})\otimes L_{h^{(2)}}(\la^{(2)})\otimes\cdots\otimes L_{h^{(M)}}(\la^{(M)}).
\]

Then, the following two are equivalent:

- $d_i(u)$ ($1\leq i\leq m+n$) act semisimply on $V_{\underline{h}}(\underline{\la})$,

- If $\la_1^{(s)}+h^{(s)}\geq \la_1^{(t)}+h^{(t)}$ for some $1\leq s\neq t\leq M$, there is $\text{max}\{0,\la_m^{(s)}-n\}+h^{(s)}-\la_1^{(t)}-h^{(t)}\geq k_s-1$ and if $\la_{m+1}^{(s)}-h^{(s)}\leq \la_{m+1}^{(t)}-h^{(t)}$, there is $\la_{m+n}^{(t)}-h^{(t)}-\la_{m+1}^{(s)}+h^{(s)}\geq j_t-i_s+1$ for $1\leq s\leq M-1$ satisfying $j_t\geq i_s$.

In particular, $V_{\underline{h}}(\underline{\la})$ is a simple $\Ymn$-module in this case.
card.label: Theorem 45

paper.title: Representations of Super Yangians with Gelfand-Tsetlin bases
paper.abstract: The evaluation homomorphism from the super Yangian $\mathrm Y(\mathfrak{gl}_{m|n})$ to the universal enveloping algebra $\mathrm U(\mathfrak{gl}_{m|n})$ allows one to regard the $\mathfrak{gl}_{m|n}$-modules as $\mathrm Y(\mathfrak{gl}_{m|n})$-modules. In this paper, we establish necessary and sufficient conditions for simple tensor products of covariant evaluation modules to be tame. We also provide an explicit construction of Gelfand-Tsetlin bases for tensor products of skew modules.
